british-chiropractic-association.name: British Chiropractic Association
british-chiropractic-association.brief: The UK's largest chiropractic membership body. Kat led its marketing and communications arm, a website rebuild with two outside agencies, its 100th year anniversary campaign, and the social channels that carry its events to members.

genesis-ix.name: Genesis IX
genesis-ix.brief: A specialist foreign exchange fund in Gibraltar, speaking to professional investors. It had a strategy and a team. It needed a name, a look and a voice that felt as disciplined as the way it trades.

leftfield-learning.name: Leftfield Learning
leftfield-learning.brief: A small alternative provision team working one to one with young people who struggle in school. They knew their ethos. They had no brand, no website and nothing to put in front of a local authority panel.

mr-strongmans.name: Mr Strongmans Creatine
mr-strongmans.brief: A Bournemouth sports nutrition brand with a great product and no identity to sell it. The founders needed a brand that looks as credible as the big names beside it, and one they can carry from the shelf to their website and social.
